known_weaknesses: The held-out condition-benefit receipt is live:false and does not prove live Tau held-out execution.
The held-out condition-benefit metric is mean_belief_brier, while earlier calibration/planning discussions also used mean_action_brier and planning regret.

A later issue comment reports a degenerate all-TRUE sealed_test corpus/estimator problem; this report therefore treats held-out benefit as archived stop-condition evidence, not as a reliable headline benefit claim.
PCTOM-R2 readiness is a research workstream receipt, not proof of Embry's persistent persona, dream-to-session continuity, Chatterbox perceived emotion, or full Phase 01-16 media reliability.
